## Samsara Brings Connected Operations to the Ice with Laval Rocket Partnership


September 28, 2026


*Season-long sponsorship equips Place Bell’s ice resurfacers with Samsara technology and brings fans closer to the game*


**LAVAL, Quebec, September 28, 2026** —[Samsara Inc.](https://www.samsara.com/) ("Samsara") (NYSE: IOT), the pioneer of the Connected Operations® Platform, today announced its first professional hockey sponsorship, a season-long partnership with the[Laval Rocket](https://www.samsara.com/ca/blog/laval-rocket-hockey-partnership) , the American Hockey League affiliate of the Montreal Canadiens. Samsara-branded Zamboni® ice resurfacers, equipped with Samsara 360 Camera and Vehicle Gateway devices, will help keep the rink ready for play.


The partnership spans the 2026-27 regular season, beginning with the home opener on Friday, October 2. It brings the same technology that organizations across Quebec rely on for the safety, efficiency, and sustainability of their operations into a setting where fans can see it at work throughout the season.


“Ice conditions affect everything from the speed of the game to player safety,” said Marc-Antoine Lavigne, Director, Corporate Partnerships at the Laval Rocket. “Our operators take great pride in what they do. Samsara gives them new, real-time insights and a unique experience for fans. We're excited to welcome Samsara to Place Bell.”


The ice resurfacers are equipped with two Samsara technologies:


-


**360 Camera** : Gives a perspective other cameras can't, showing the rink from the machine's point of view, looking out in every direction


-


**Vehicle Gateway** : Captures performance data, helping the Place Bell crew keep the machines in top shape


“Samsara works with organizations across Quebec that serve communities every day, and hockey is a shared passion for many of them,” said Liz Klein, Area Vice President, Canada at Samsara. “Our partnership with the Laval Rocket gives us an opportunity to support a team our customers cheer for and the people behind the scenes whose work makes every home game possible.”


Fans will also have opportunities to get closer to the action throughout the season. The Samsara partnership also supports the Laval Rocket's raffle of seats in the first row behind the player bench, along with the chance for one child per home game to ride an ice resurfacer between periods. Eligibility requirements and entry details will be available on the Laval Rocket website.


To learn more about how Samsara helps Canadian organizations strengthen their operations, visit[Samsara Canada](https://www.samsara.com/ca) .


**About Samsara**


Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations® Platform, which is an open platform that connects the people, devices, and systems of some of the world’s most complex operations, allowing them to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. With tens of thousands of customers across North America and Europe, Samsara is a proud technology partner to the people who keep our global economy running, including the world’s leading organizations across industries in transportation, construction, wholesale and retail trade, field services, logistics, manufacturing, utilities and energy, government, healthcare and education, food and beverage, and others. The company's mission is to increase the safety, efficiency, and sustainability of the operations that power the global economy.
